intermediate.name: Pietra di Bismantova
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Pietra di Bismantova (181.1 km)

story: Repeated attacks marked the opening kilometres, though no break formed immediately. Eventually, a large group went clear at the foot of the Alpe San Pellegrino. Fortunato accelerated from the break, reducing the front group to five riders, but they were caught on the final climb. Carapaz attacked from the peloton, went over the top with a 30-second lead and held on over the final 4.5 kilometres.
